summary: Zhibao Technology Inc., a Cayman Islands exempted company, filed a Form 6-K reporting an amendment to its senior secured convertible promissory notes issued to 3i, LP. The amendment, dated August 5, 2026, lowered the Floor Price definition from $0.30 to $0.22, subject to adjustment for splits and recapitalizations. The April 2026 note had a principal of $3,333,333 and the June 2026 note $555,556, with all other terms unchanged. This is a material modification of convertible note terms, not a routine filing, but not a classic special-situation category. Watch for potential dilution impact and conversion dynamics at the lower floor price.
